question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

Prashant is __obstinate__ by nature.
solution: The correct answer is “**adamant**”. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • "**Obstinate**" describes someone who is stubbornly refusing to change one's opinion or chosen course of action, despite attempts to persuade one to do so. (जिद्दी) • **Example**- Prashant is obstinate and will not listen to reason. • "**Adamant**" means refusing to be persuaded or to change one's mind. (अटल) • **Example**- She is adamant that she will not resign. • Hence, the word that is similar in meaning to the given word is 'Adamant’. Therefore, the correct answer is ‘**Option 1**’. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ ** • Let’s have a look at the meaning of the remaining options. • "**Pliable**" means flexible or easily bent. (लचीला) • "**Generous**" refers to someone showing a readiness to give more of something, especially money, than is strictly necessary or expected. (उदार) • "**Flexible**" describes someone who is ready and able to change so as to adapt to different circumstances. (लचीला) 38:Tc23,
